svg.text: Washers: 16 mm outside, 8.5 mm hole, 3 mm thick; cut 78 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sheet's offcuts in the same laser run.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stacks of 9 go between the spine and each stay at the four stay bolts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (27 mm); stacks of 3 go between the bulkhead and the box (9 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tubes: saw 16 x 2 mm steel tube into four 60.0 mm lengths, square the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends with a file. One goes inside the spine at each stay bolt so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolt cannot squeeze the side plates together.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each tube is 60.0 mm long, give or take 0.2 mm.
